## What's changed

- Made main-program audio the first priority for default playback so commentary and descriptive tracks cannot outrank the movie or episode soundtrack.
- Preferred English main audio, then selected the best compatible track using channel count, codec quality, bitrate, and player capabilities.
- Preserved manual audio-track selection, including commentary tracks when a user explicitly chooses one.
- Applied the same automatic audio selection to Tube TV programs, commercials, and bumpers.
- Expanded audio metadata detection and added regression coverage for lossless main tracks competing with compatible commentary tracks.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
